Question 12
?

Which of the following is equivalent to ∫C(x−2y)dx+2xdy, where C is part of the ellipse 9x2+y2=9 traversed in the counterclockwise direction from the point A(0,3) to the point B(0,−3).

a
∫π/23π/26−sin⁡tcos⁡tdt
b
 ∫π/23π/23−sin2⁡tcos⁡tdt
c
 ∫π/23π/26sin2⁡t−cos⁡tdt
d
 2∫π/23π/2sin⁡tcos2⁡tdt
e
 ∫π/23π/23sin⁡t+cos⁡tdt
